quotes.text: Azure Advisor is a free, built-in cloud consultant that analyzes your entire Azure environment. It doesn't just sit there. It actively scans your resources and compares them against Microsoft's best practices.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: A compact definition of what Azure Advisor is and does.

quotes.text: A backup you've never restored isn't a backup. It's a hope. Advisor will remind you to test your restore process regularly.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters

quotes.text: By the time users complain about slow load times, you've already lost trust. Advisor helps you catch those problems early.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters

quotes.text: Start with the advisor score. That single number tells you where you stand today. Look at your overall score, then check which pillar is dragging you down. Focus on the lowest score first.

quotes.text: Combine advisor with Azure Policy to enforce standards automatically. When advisor tells you something is wrong, create a policy that prevents it from happening again. That turns one time fixes into ongoing compliance.

quotes.why: Practical recommendation that turns one-off fixes into lasting governance.

chapters.title: How Advisor works and its five pillars
The Advisor score and getting started

takeaways: Azure Advisor is free and built into the Azure portal; it compares your resources against the Azure Well-Architected Framework and gives personalized recommendations across cost, security, reliability, performance and operational excellence.

Recommendations carry high, medium or low impact, and the Advisor score from 0 to 100% shows per pillar where your environment falls short so you can tackle the lowest score and high-impact items first.
Pairing Advisor with Azure Policy and a regular weekly or monthly review cadence turns one-time fixes into ongoing compliance.
hook: Many teams treat Azure Advisor as a passive list of suggestions they ignore. This episode is for Azure admins and beginners and explains its five pillars, how the Advisor score is calculated and how to act on high-impact recommendations to cut costs and improve security and reliability.
